notes.title: Check out the unmissable Curve Hidden Gems bundle
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce a new bundle, available to buy now on the Steam storefront! With its combined 40% discount, the Hidden Gems bundle features a whopping 18 classic titles from the Curve back catalogue!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48166/Curve_Games_Hidden_Gems

Taking in just about every genre you can think of, the Hidden Gems bundle is packed full of fan favourites that are guaranteed to keep everyone entertained over the Christmas holidays and beyond.

Already got some of these classics in your collection? No problem! As with every Steam bundle you won’t pay twice for any of the games you already own, making this the perfect way to round out your Curve collection.

Here’s every game included in the Hidden Gems bundle:

[list]
[*] 10 Second Ninja X - (Platformer)
[*] American Fugitive - (Action / Top-down shooter)
[*] Hotshot Racing - (Racing)
[*] Hue - (Puzzle platformer)
[*] Iron Fisticle - (Top-down shooter)

[*] The Indie Mixtape - (Action / Adventure / RPG)

There’s plenty for everyone in the Hidden Gems bundle, and it’s sure to keep you all nice and busy through these cold winter months!

notes.title: Win Boxed Hue Collector's Edition in New Competition!
notes.content:
Hey Hue fans! Can you believe it's been nearly 8 years since I released Hue? Holy crap, that's ages, what have I been doing with my life.

Anyway, to celebrate me wasting my life, I have a brand new competition where you can win the out-of-print Hue Collector's Edition! This is super hard to find these days, and may actually be worth something down your local pawn shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25942032/cd0b76e33c5d7897008bb4db8f3c3095059e3891.png[/img]

What's included:
[list]
[*] Standard Edition Box
[*] DRM-free game disc
[*] Official soundtrack
[*] Full-color instruction manual
[*] Hue-Bik's Cube
[*] Flask Plush
[*] Hue Figure
[/list]
So what's the catch? Well I'm the creator of Hue, and I have a new game Paper Trail out today! In the game Hue makes a special appearance - and you need to find him - and bring him back alive. You can find the game below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1889740/Paper_Trail/

So to win you need to:
[list]
[*] Play my new game Paper Trail.
[*] Find the secret Hue!
[*] Leave a comment below here when you find him.
[*] We'll choose a winner at random and announce in two weeks!
[/list]
Good luck!

notes.title: CURVE GAMES ANNOUNCE THEIR LATEST RELEASE IS COMING ON NOVEMBER 2ND
notes.content:
[b]For The King II is coming to Steam on November 2nd[/b] and we could not be more excited that you will be setting foot once again into Fahrul on an adventure of a lifetime.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676840/For_The_King_II/

The game has taken a small team of thirteen over three years to craft and bring to life. Being a rogue-lite game that encourages you to replay again and again, we hope that you and your friends will enjoy For The King II for years to come as you explore all that Farhul has to offer. We can’t wait for you to loot all the items, weapons and attire that you can lay your hands on, and unravel all the mysteries that await you, all whilst realising your true potential as a freedom fighter within the Resistance.

[h3][u][b]Exclusive Pre-Purchase Rewards[/b][/u][/h3]
We have created an exclusive offer for adventurers who pre-purchase the game before launch day. This special offer is for the brave souls willing to sign up early to join the Resistance and be the first to set foot on the path to freedom once the fight begins on [b]November 2nd[/b].

We have assembled the finest gifts to aid you on your quest to ensure you traverse Fahrul’s paths, forests, swamps, seas and dungeons in style, with the rousing chorus of the Resistance orchestra in your ears to spur you on in the darkest of moments.

Alongside these bounteous gifts, pre-purchasers will also enjoy a 10% discount on the price of the game! This discount will be available for a limited time during For The King II’s launch.

notes.title: Summer Sale 2023
notes.content:
Summer has arrived, bringing with it the warmth of sunshine and the excitement of this sizzling Summer Sale! As the days get longer and the temperature rises, there's no better time to dive into some thrilling gaming adventures and enjoy fantastic deals. 

Embrace the spirit of the season with our incredible discounts on all titles in our vast catalog. We have something for everyone, whether you're craving action, adventure, or strategy. Enjoy captivating and exciting games like Human Fall Flat, The Ascent, Blooming Business: Casino, From Space, and the adventurous Patch Quest.  

So, grab your sunglasses, controller, mouse & keyboard, and get ready for a very hot gaming summer! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/curvesummer][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/854f506495036857d1dff23e769c6769033079d9.png[/img][/url]

[/h1]
Join the crew and become a protector of The Citadel!  

Customize your battle wagon with a wide range of components and weapons, transforming it into a formidable force. Manage your crew's actions individually in combat, from manning guns to repairing vehicle components. Navigate hazardous environments and face off against savage militia groups led by crazed Warlords. Make strategic decisions that shape the campaign map and influence faction control.  

Your choices and skills will determine your success, plan wisely and fight fiercely! Wishlist and start your adventure into the lawless Badlands!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078230/

[h1]Dungeons of Hinterberg  
[/h1]
Grab your sword and prepare for an unforgettable adventure in the enchanting alpine village of Hinterberg!  

Join Luisa to conquer the mysterious Dungeons of Hinterberg. Immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of this idyllic Austrian Alps destination as you navigate the charming village and uncover the hidden magic within its dungeons. Prepare yourself for a vacation like no other, where adventure and magic intertwine in the alpine paradise.  

Wishlist and join Luisa on the path to becoming a Master Slayer! Welcome to Hinterberg, where the magic of the dungeons awaits your arrival! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983260/

[h1]Kitbash Model Club 
[/h1]
Welcome to the sun-kissed paradise of Wirraway Island! 

Prepare for an exhilarating adventure where innovation meets limitless possibilities. Here, you have the power to transform your most daring RC model construction dreams into tangible reality. Unleash your creativity and push the boundaries of performance.  

Wish list now and embark on this extraordinary journey today and watch as your imagination takes flight! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2107090/Kitbash_Model_Club/

[h1]Goblin Stone 
[/h1]
Attention, Gobbos! 

A new Dev Blog is out; check all the recent news about Goblin Stone and get ready to fight back! Goblins, orcs, and other monster folk rise against extinction. Wishlist now and join the Goblins in their fight for survival in this roguelike-turned-based RPG. Together, we will triumph! 

Onward, brave souls! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521970/Goblin_Stone/

[h1]For The King II  
[/h1]
Inspired by classic tabletop adventures. Prepare to confront Fahrul's once beloved Queen turned tyrant and her army of fearsome Queensguard in the highly anticipated sequel to For The King.  

Whether alone or with a party of four, unravel dark secrets, battle, loot and experience the thrill of this turn-based roguelike RPG.  Discover a host of fresh features, fearsome enemies and devilish dungeons across brand new epic campaigns.  Wishlist the game now and embark on a quest like no other. The Resistance is rising, join us Adventurers! 

Don’t miss the Curve bundles selection. Take advantage of this Sale, save money, and enjoy the spring season by adding some terrific games to your collection!
